body:
Recently I found a lot of Amanita in the area around where I live.  Usually before I try a new substance I do a lot of reading on the subject, though this time I wanted to go into the experience with an unbiased opinion, so I decided not to worry too much and simply see what happened.
I started out by taking about 15g of dried Amanita orally...  I waited about an hour before the effects kicked in.  I became very sick to my stomach.  I was able to keep from puking by smoking about a half gram of pot.  I began slobering on my self relentlessly.  I begin to sink into the floor of my apartment into my neighbor's apartment below me.  I was EXTREMELY lethargic.
By this point in time, a friend of mine, who is obssessed with 'bumping' or insuflating things, suggested that I try to grind up, and bump some Amanita.  And so, I did.  My friend took a coffee grinder, ground up what he said was about 5 grams, put a tray and rolled up 20$ bill for me, and I proceeded to bump every last bit of dried fungi off the tray.  NOT A GOOD IDEA.  It tasted and smelled like I had cat food dripping down my throat for about the next 8 hours.  Though, I know I became considerably more messed up.  After about another hour I had lost the ability to move all together and wasn't sure if I was awake or not.
It was a profound experience, one that I will do again in time.  But, I definetly won't bump the stuff... the horrible 'drip' taste in my throat nearly ruined my trip!
